reason: As someone who got a refund last time and has already given this month, B answers my real worry: it states plainly that the campaign is all-or-nothing and my pledge is returned in full if they fall short, names the Majestic and a real person (Ruth Albers), and gives concrete differences from last time. A leaves placeholders for the name and group, never says what happens to my money if it fails again, and leans on vaguer reassurance.
